limits: Linux local execution only; native macOS/Windows behavior requires fresh hosted checks.
The producer is the real compiler under a cfg(test) checkpoint; this is not a pristine shipping CLI killed by spontaneous timing.
Shipping inspection/recovery binary has no test hook and runs from a separate copied location.
Inventories compare file bytes, paths and directories; timestamps, inode identity and read-access metadata are not asserted.
Participating local processes only; no hostile filesystem, network-filesystem or power-loss guarantee.
candidateSourceState: Working-tree candidate over the full base revision; source and executable hashes identify the executed bytes. Exact immutable PR head and represented merge candidate are recorded separately after publication.

validation.integrity: Six standalone verifiers, valid source fixture, compileall and JSON checks pass; extraction baseline is preserved and three evolved CLI hashes/rationales are updated.
validation.independentReview: No remaining production blockers; review discovered and verified the fix for lossy/native output-root aliasing.
validation.hosted: Fresh Linux/macOS/Windows source-install/clean-room, public smoke and advisory runs are required for the exact PR candidate; local Linux does not establish native platform evidence.

testEvidenceClasses.integration: Synthetic valid v2 retained-journal fixtures exercised through a copied shipping CLI; not a spontaneous interruption claim.
testEvidenceClasses.runtimeReplay: Real compiler/pipeline and journal publication with a cfg(test) first-mutation pause; producer killed/reaped and unmodified shipping CLI executes inspection/recovery.
testEvidenceClasses.artifactIsolation: Final full suite, strict lint and replay artifacts built in an independent clean target directory. Earlier shared-target stale-binary/ExecutableFileBusy observations are not passing evidence; no busy/spawn retry was added.
